chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Wuhayb ibn Hafs, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام: How should I act when I go out with a funeral bier? Should I walk in front of it, behind it, on its right, or on its left?
He عليه السلام said: “If he is a mukhalif, then do not walk in front of him, for the angels of punishment receive him with various kinds of punishment.”

key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or funeral procession accompanying the deceased
key_terms.بِأَنْوَاعِ الْعَذَابِ: with various forms or kinds of punishment
key_terms.مُخَالِفًا: one who is opposed in belief; here, a religious dissenter
key_terms.يَسْتَقْبِلُونَهُ: they receive or confront him upon his passage

ai.seo_question: Where should one walk in a funeral procession according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the etiquette and ruling concerning how one walks with a funeral procession. It states that in the case of a mukhalif, one should not walk in front of the جنازة, because the angels of punishment are receiving him with different kinds of punishment.
